empty.title: Your band is waiting on the first nights
empty.body: When the overnight reading lands, we start gathering your personal normal range. No alarm — just an empty track.

building.title: Building your band
building.body: 7 nights build your personal band. No alarm — just data collecting.

engine.below: The engine read last night's HRV below your band and eases today's squat top set.
engine.above: The engine read last night's HRV above your band — the body is ready; today's session runs as planned.

band.disclaimer: HRV is a recovery signal — not a diagnosis.

trends.title: Trend
trends.subtitle: Your HRV over time — the daily reading, your 7-day mean and your normal range.

page.title: HRV
page.subtitle: Your heart-rate variability — a daily read on how ready your body is to train.
page.connectTitle: Let HRV run in the background.
page.connectBody: HRV — heart-rate variability — tells how recovered you are. Connect a wearable and MakeIt syncs your HRV every morning. No manual reading, no extra routine — it is just there when you wake up.
page.connectStep1Body: One tap — you approve access with your wearable provider.
page.connectStep2Body: MakeIt fetches last night's reading automatically. You do nothing.
page.connectStep3Body: The first couple of weeks MakeIt learns your normal — then you see readiness.
page.connectAppleNote: Apple Watch support arrives with the MakeIt iPhone app.
